episodes.title: छठ माँ की कथा: राजा प्रियव्रत के शिशु को जीवन मिला
episodes.description: एक भावनात्मक कथा जहाँ राजा प्रियव्रत की निराशा, दिव्य करुणा और छठी माँ की असीम शक्ति एकत्रित होती है। सुनिए कैसे एक मृत शिशु को जीवन का उपहार मिला और छठ व्रत की उत्पत्ति हुई।
episodes.summary: In the ancient kingdom of Kosala, King Priyavrat, haunted by childlessness, performed intense prayers to the heavens, yearning for an heir. The people whispered about a divine mother who could grant his wish, and his desperation set the stage for a miraculous tale. This opening draws listeners into a world where hope battles despair. When the queen finally gave birth, the newborn lay lifeless in her arms, and the kingdom fell into deep sorrow. Priyavrat’s heart shattered, but the radiant form of Chhathi Maiya appeared, her golden complexion glowing as she held a pitcher of sacred water. With compassion, she poured the holy water over the infant, breathing divine life back into the child, turning grief into joy. The revived child’s cries echoed across the palace, signaling the triumph of divine grace. Chhathi Maiya instructed the king to observe a sacred fast and worship the sun, birthing the tradition of Chhath Vrat. As the story concludes, listeners are blessed with the lesson that devotion and divine mercy restore life, and they receive Chhathi Maiya’s blessings for prosperity and health.
